nature: REAL measured data only. No synthetic data in this file. Simulation files shipped by the publishers are listed as such and never used as measurements.
base_dir: Paths are relative to the scratch folder <scratchpad>/real/ populated by fetch_and_describe.py fetch; no raw data is stored in the repository.
row_convention: rowStart/rowEnd/stepRow are 0-based data-row indices, header row(s) excluded, inclusive bounds. For csv members: index 0 = first line after the header. For the CSTR xlsx: index 0 = sheet row 3. For InTaSet xlsx: index 0 = sheet row 2.
screening_rule: fetch_and_describe.py RULE (declared before screening): single input change, baseline >= 10 s with drift < 10 % of |dY|, plateau >= 30 s, drift over the last 10 s < 5 % of |dY|, |dY| >= 10 x baseline sd. Known limitation: windows are in absolute seconds, so for slow processes a still-moving response can pass; every segment below was also examined by hand.

summary.why: No dataset reachable from the allowed hosts contains two independent open-loop step trials on the same input/output channel, nor a closed-loop trial whose controller settings (Kp, Ti, Td, period) are published.

caveats: row 0 excluded: T1 = T2 = 23 exactly, TCLab model default, not a measurement

response NOT settled at rowEnd: slope over rows 270-299 = 0.078 degC/s (about 17 % of dY per 100 s); T1 keeps rising to 83.9 degC later (with Q2 also on). The declared rule flags it CANDIDATE only because its 10 s end window cannot resolve this drift under 0.49 degC quantization
single trial: no independent second trial on the Q1->T1 channel exists in the dataset

segments_rejected.reason: cross-coupling channel, far from settled (end drift about 84 % of dY per 100 s)

flagged CANDIDATE by the rule, rejected on inspection: the 'baseline' rows 270-299 are the transient driven by the Q1 step (T2 rising 0.068 degC/s); the response is a superposition of two inputs, not a step from a steady state
baseline drift (T1 still rising from the Q1 step)

0 candidates under the declared rule in the 8 InTaSet-ID files: the longest constant-input plateau per file is 62-104 s (any pump change counted) and the levels are still moving at the end of every plateau; no units documented for levels or pumps

integrity anomaly: for rows 700-3599 versus rows 3020-5919 (offset 2320 rows = 232 s), Tank 2 and Tank 3 are bit-identical on 2300 of 2900 rows, Tank 1 and Tank 4 differ slightly; the second half cannot be treated as an independent repetition

0 candidates: four inputs excited by a multilevel PRBS, plateaus 46-166 s, reactor temperature drifting (31 to 52 degC over 1565 s); units of 'Hot oil circulation' (0-440) and 'Hot Oil bath' (0-230) not stated
each xlsx holds one unlabelled column (tray temperature, presumably degC) without time, input, step instant or step amplitude: gain and time constant cannot be identified

candidate_pairs_rejected.reason: the validation record is MIMO with both heaters moving continuously; predicting T1 needs a 2x2 model, and the Q2->T1 / Q2->T2 channels cannot be identified cleanly from the SISO record (Q2 step taken during the Q1 transient). Also different operating point (46-74 degC), same kit TCLab_001, dates of both runs unpublished, raw noise about 1.0-1.3 degC (sd of first differences / sqrt 2).

closed_loop_undocumented.note: Q1_pct jumps by +10 at row 1350 when d1 = 10, so Q includes the disturbance. Controller not a PID and its realization is not published (preprint arXiv:2611.21200 gives no numeric controller). Companion files: *_real_filtered.csv (low-pass filtered measurements, not raw) and simulation_mimo_robust_control_simulation.csv (SIMULATION, not a measurement).
